scope: Storage footprint analysis for Room SQLite and SwiftData user persistence

tables_entities: saved_trip_stops (12 columns, index on PK + FK index on tripId)
schema_footprint.binary_blobs: ZERO binary images stored in database. All images referenced by HTTPS/relative URL strings.

projected_usage.light_user: 5 saved places, 1 saved trip (6 stops): ~4 KB total payload (< 64 KB SQLite page allocation)
projected_usage.heavy_traveler: 100 saved places, 20 saved trips (150 stops): ~60 KB total payload (< 256 KB SQLite file)
projected_usage.app_size_impact: Negligible. Native SQLite overhead < 0.1% of baseline APK/IPA.
